story:
Logline: Yooba remembers the village the way he tells everything, far too fast and a bit too pleased with himself, and the morning the sky went red, when he swallowed the diamonds to hide them.
Characters: Yooba: wants you to see how good it was; fast, wet, proud. Hero: asleep in his armour through the festival, then flat. Announcer: pleased.
Turn: The sky does the thing and Yooba swallows a handful of diamonds.
Payoff: On the Landing the hero: 'You've been carrying those the whole time.' Yooba: 'Yes?' The announcer: a very nice village.
Why it matters: Video7 after Level 13 (Floor 959), written in Docs/LoreVideos.md; Hell's showmanship and repetition, no office jokes, slimes are villagers.
Who it's for: anyone, no game knowledge needed.
